summary.en: One @ for everything: type @ and what you want, no command names to learn. Also a new panel look, Traditional Chinese, removing candidates for good, image previews in clipboard history, and a notification when a new version is out.
summary.zh: 一个 @ 搞定：打 @ 再打你想要的，不用记命令名。还有新的面板外观、繁体中文、永久删除候选词、剪贴板历史的大图预览，以及有新版本时的通知。
